item.title: 'The Finance Industry Is a Grift,' Oren Cass Claims in the New York Times. Look Who’s Talking.

Instead, his aides pointed to the “broader reality” of race relations in the Jim Crow South. item.title: Angsty Journalists Said the WaPo Sports Section Was Indispensable. The Evidence Suggests Otherwise.
item.description: The Washington Post shuttered its so-called sports section last week amid sweeping layoffs intended to transform the once-revered paper into a product that makes money because people actually want to read it.
